title: Packages
description: Your parcels in Hyper+Space, on its page and in the menu bar, no account or key: type a tracking number and a name, and Packages names the carrier from the number. Opening a parcel reads its events from the carrier's own public tracking where that works without a key (MaltaPost, and Cainiao for China Post and AliExpress; on a Mac set to Malta, MaltaPost for every international post number too), only when you open it or press Refresh, never in the background; the number goes to that site. For other carriers (DHL, UPS, USPS, Royal Mail) Return opens their tracking page, or 17track's. Rename a parcel, mark it delivered, remove it. The menu bar item and its Dock widget show how many are on the way.
examples: Hyper+Space › Packages, type LX123456789CN shoes and press Return: kept as shoes
Type track 1Z999AA10123456784 lamp in Hyper+Space and press Return: Packages keeps it, and the menu bar shows 📦 1
